title: ficus infectoria var. psychotriifolium
intro: Ficus infectoria var. psychotriifolium, commonly known as the Indian fig or Jivaka, is a plant species used in traditional medicine. This plant has been found to have various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and exhibiting antioxidant properties, which can help protect against cell damage and oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Ficus infectoria var. psychotriifolium include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in treating wounds, skin conditions, and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
